group.label: General Settings
group.comment: When enabled, out-of-stock products show a "Notify Me" form so customers can subscribe to stock alerts.

field.label: Enable Stock Alerts
field.comment: Show stock alert subscription form on out-of-stock product pages.

field.label: Allow Guest Subscriptions
field.comment: Allow visitors who are not logged in to subscribe by entering their email address.

field.label: Product Page Display Style
field.comment: Compact shows one "Notify me when back in stock" link that opens the form in a dialog, so the product info column stays short. Full form shows the whole subscription card on the page (the style used before version 1.1.8).

group.label: Email Notifications
group.comment: Configure how back-in-stock notification emails are sent. The template can be customized under Marketing > Email Templates.

field.label: Email Sender Identity
field.comment: Choose which store email identity sends the back-in-stock notifications.

field.label: Email Template
field.comment: Select the transactional email template for back-in-stock notifications.

group.label: Abuse Protection
group.comment: Limits how often one client IP address can call the storefront subscribe and unsubscribe endpoints. The client IP is taken from Magento's remote address, which honours the trusted proxy headers configured in app/etc/env.php.

field.label: Requests per Window
field.comment: Maximum subscribe or unsubscribe requests allowed per IP address in one window. Further requests get HTTP 429. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 10.

field.label: Window Length (seconds)
field.comment: Length of the rate limit window in seconds. Default: 600.

group.label: Design & Colors
group.comment:
Colors for the stock alert form are managed centrally in your theme configuration file.

File: app/design/frontend/Panth/Infotech/web/tailwind/theme-config.json
Section: modules.low-stock-notification

After changing colors, run node generate-theme-css.js to regenerate CSS variables.
